title: When Anxiety Comes
description: Six minutes to make room for anxiety, instead of trying to push it away.

segments.say: This practice won't take the anxiety away. We're just going to make room for it.
Sit or stand, however you are.
Begin by lengthening the out-breath. Breathe in, and let it out more slowly than you took it in.
Now notice where the anxiety is in your body. The chest, the throat, the belly.
Don't try to change it. Just notice its shape.
If you can, say silently: this is anxiety, and it will pass.
Anxiety is a feeling, not a prediction.
Come back to the long breath. Breathe in, and let it out slowly.
You don't need it to leave in order to go on with your day.
When you're ready, look around, and come back.
